# AUDAZ Agency LLC
> We don't do quiet.

AUDAZ Agency LLC is a bilingual (English/Spanish) AI consulting and marketing agency based in South Florida. Founded by Rene Galan, Co-Founder and AI Consulting Director, AUDAZ brings 40+ years of media and marketing experience — including work with Fortune 500 brands like AT&T, Google Fiber, Adidas, Yeti, Dell, and Casio — to small businesses who deserve world-class thinking.

AUDAZ is the leading bilingual GEO/AEO (Generative Engine Optimization / Answer Engine Optimization) agency serving the Latin small business market in South Florida and globally.

## Services

### GEO & AI Visibility (Generative Engine Optimization)
AUDAZ helps businesses get recommended by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity. This is the agency's flagship AI service — bilingual GEO/AEO implementation for small businesses.

4-Phase Process:
- Phase 1: AI Visibility Audit (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity)
- Phase 2: GEO Foundation (schema markup, structured content, brand entity building)
- Phase 3: Authority Building (citations, mentions, trusted publications)
- Phase 4: Monthly Monitoring (AI Brand Score, share of voice reporting)

Free 48-hour AI Visibility Audit available at https://audaz.agency/geo

### Website Design & Development
Custom, mobile-first, SEO-ready websites built to convert. Bilingual EN/ES by default.

### Marketing Strategy
Brand positioning, audience research, content and channel strategy, and quarterly growth roadmaps — built on Seth Godin's principles of finding and serving your tribe.

### Video Production
Brand films, social media reels, bilingual video scripts, editing, and ad-ready video assets. Mentored by broadcast television veterans.

### Digital Advertising
Google Search & Display, Meta (Facebook & Instagram) advertising. Built on media principles used for AT&T and Google Fiber campaigns.

### Content Creation
Bilingual social media content calendars, blog writing (EN & ES), email newsletters, branded graphics, and SEO content strategy.

### Podcasting
Full podcast launch, production, and distribution. Bilingual episode support available.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is AUDAZ Agency?**
AUDAZ Agency LLC is a bilingual (EN/ES) AI consulting and marketing agency based in South Florida. We bring 40+ years of Fortune 500 marketing experience to small businesses — in English and in Spanish.

**What is GEO/AEO and why does my business need it?**
GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) are how your business gets recommended by AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity. Traditional SEO gets you on Google. GEO/AEO gets you into AI-generated answers — the fastest-growing discovery channel for businesses today.

**Does AUDAZ work with businesses outside South Florida?**
Yes. While AUDAZ is based in South Florida, we serve businesses globally — especially bilingual and Latin-owned businesses in the United States and Latin America.

**What makes AUDAZ different from other marketing agencies?**
Three things: (1) True bilingual EN/ES fluency — not translation, but cultural marketing. (2) 40+ years of Fortune 500 experience applied to small business budgets. (3) We are the only agency specifically focused on GEO/AEO for the bilingual Latin business market.

**How do I get started with AUDAZ?**
Book a free 60-minute consultation at https://audaz.agency/contact — no pitch, no pressure, just 40 years of expertise working for your business. A free 48-hour AI Visibility Audit is also available.

**What languages does AUDAZ work in?**
English and Spanish. All services available bilingually.
